Alex Chen: Hey team — prospect just sent final POC checklist. Two immediate asks: 1) BYO-HSM failover RTO of <=2m across AZs, 2) full pen-test schedule for Redwood proxy when we run against customer KMS.
Maria Gomez: thanks Alex. who owns the BYO-HSM network runbook?
Devon Li: I can take runbook ownership. quick Q: is the customer using CloudHSM or an on-prem HSM? affects our proxy topology and attestation needs.
Alex Chen: CloudHSM (AWS) multi-AZ cluster. Customer insists CMK never leaves their keystore and wants rotation hooks + audit events exported to their SIEM.
Samir Patel: For SIEM we can emit key usage events via our audit stream; need to confirm retention and field mapping. Also they want HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2/3 + module serial) — we'll need to include that in the SOW.
Devon Li: Notes on failover: CloudHSM cluster failover typically completes in ~30–90s but depends on network. Our recommended pattern: keep short TTL for proxies and warm standby in each AZ. That meets 2m RTO in tests.
Maria Gomez: customer asked about perf impact — what's the token cost / latency delta if we proxy to their HSM vs hosted CMK?
Devon Li: raw numbers from internal tests: proxy adds ~6–12ms p99 for token signing flows, and ~0.8–1.5x CPU on the proxy node under high QPS. For serving (text gen embeddings) overhead is negligible because crypto ops are off critical path, but for sealed encryption used in metadata, expect added RTT.
Alex Chen: they also require a scheduled rotation window (every 30 days) with zero-downtime key versioning. can we support in-place rotation with cached KV invalidation hooks?
Devon Li: yes — we support key-rotation handshake: create new key version, dual-write for TTL, then switch pointers. We provide a KV cache invalidation webhook that the customer can call from their rotation job. Example snippet we give customers:
```
POST /v1/invalidate-cache
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{ "key_id": "projects/123/keys/customer-cmk" }
```
Samir Patel: pen-test ask: they want Redwood proxy in scope for external auth and replay tests. We need to provide contact for scheduling and a temporary test endpoint. policy: tests only during agreed window, no destructive actions, creds rotated after test.
Maria Gomez: pricing angle: they want delta for Dedicated proxy + HSM egress costs. Devon, can you estimate per-month delta for 1000 qps steady, 12h/day?
Devon Li: rough calc: proxy infra + egress ~ $2.6k/mo for those load numbers (includes reserved proxy pool, monitoring, and extra audit retention). Add HSM request ops (CloudHSM) — depends on AWS pricing but plan for an additional $0.01–0.03 per op at scale. I'll write up a concise cost table for the quote.
Alex Chen: perfect. Action items: 1) Devon — produce a one-page runbook showing failover design + network diagram, 2) Samir — draft pen-test checklist and contact window, 3) Maria — ask finance for a preliminary delta and include attestation certification add-on pricing.
Samir Patel: pinging sec-bot to attach latest attestation template.
sec-bot: Attached: /policies/hsm-attestation-template-v2.pdf :paperclip:
Maria Gomez: thanks — I'll sync with legal on the SOW language for attestation and rotation.
Devon Li: I'll drop the runbook + perf numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Alex Chen: Customer follow-up planned tomorrow 10am PT — Maria + Devon on the call. I'll prep the demo of a proxy failover.
Maria Gomez: ack :thumbsup:
Devon Li: ack — will include the cache invalidation snippet and a simple failover test script.
Alex Chen: great. Closing thread for now, will post updates after the prep call.
